name: Neon Raymarcher
definition: A real-time WebGL2 raymarching renderer that generates an infinite procedural synthwave city using signed-distance fields (SDFs) in a single fullscreen fragment shader, requiring no meshes, textures, or scene graph.
summary: Neon Raymarcher is a real-time WebGL2 renderer that generates an infinite procedural synthwave city using signed-distance fields in a single fragment shader, distinguished by deterministic integer hashing for synchronized building layouts.
